MISSION BRIEFING
“The missiles in Cuba are a distraction; stay focused on your objectives.
We need intel from two targets: the KGB officer in charge of their satellite program and a British ‘exporter’ delivering something suspicious.
You must also infiltrate PEARL again to discover what progress the Soviets have made on a treatment for MEDUSA. Surely they will have developed a contingency in case the plague gains a foothold in their territory.”
